svg.text: Two static bypass bits select a resistor range; eight capacitor bits set fine delay. Schmitt restoration followed by an inverter.
Default resistor sums: 320 kOhm (00), 80 kOhm (01), 245 kOhm (10), 5 kOhm (11). Switch resistance is additional.
DISCHARGE clears only these clock-timing capacitors. It has no connection to the detector SUM or CSA Cf.
